items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I had an interview recently with a drummer named Ed Soph. And we were talking about this issue.

ctx.x: I had an interview recently with a drummer named Ed Soph. And we were talking about this issue. And he said, “I’ve played with bass players and the first tune I go, “Oh God this guy really plays behind the beat so what I do is I go with that bass player and lock up at the slower tempo. The problem is if when I go down to where he is he continues to slow down. That’s a problem.”
Well that problem is easily solved by next time he’s on the gig turn it down. You know what I mean is you may say oh so-and-so is on the gig. “Oh I just realized I’m busy.”
